transfer_taxes.name: San Francisco real property transfer tax
transfer_taxes.notes: Per $500: $2.50 (>$100-$250k), $3.40 ($250k-<$1M), $3.75 ($1M-<$5M), $11.25 ($5M-<$10M), $27.50 ($10M-<$25M), $30.00 ($25M+). Bracket is chosen by the 'entire value or consideration' and applied to the whole value. SF is a consolidated city-county; no separate county DTT on top. Payer not stated on page; customarily seller.
